meta.name: add-rtk
meta.description: Install rtk token-compression proxy into agent containers. Routes Bash tool calls through rtk for 60–90% token savings on dev commands (git, cargo, pytest, docker, kubectl, etc.).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 压缩开发命令的 token 消耗，节省 60-90% 成本
copy.tagline_en: Compress token usage of dev commands, saving 60-90% costs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often run git, cargo, pytest commands in agent containers and face high token costs

howto.what: 安装 rtk 代理，自动压缩 Bash 命令的输出，节省 60–90% 的 token。运行 git、cargo、pytest 等开发命令时，Claude 会通过 rtk 处理，减少 token 消耗。
howto.when: 当你在容器中执行 Bash 工具调用（如 git status、cargo build）时触发。需要先完成安装和配置步骤。

say.text: 运行 git status 看看当前仓库状态。
say.note: rtk 会自动压缩输出，节省 token。

say.text: 帮我执行 cargo test 并显示结果。
say.note: rtk 会拦截并压缩测试输出。

say.text: 检查一下 docker ps 的输出。
say.note: rtk 会压缩 docker 命令的输出。

howto.what_en: Installs the rtk token-compression proxy and wires it into agent containers via the PreToolUse hook. Every Bash tool call is automatically filtered through rtk, saving 60–90% tokens on dev commands like git, cargo, pytest, docker, kubectl, etc.
howto.when_en: Triggered automatically on every Bash tool call (e.g., git status, cargo build) inside the configured agent container. Requires prior installation and setup steps.

say_en.text: Run git status to see the current repo state.
say_en.note: rtk compresses the output, saving tokens.

say_en.text: Execute cargo test and show results.
say_en.note: rtk intercepts and compresses test output.
